titleEn: Buttons from the Top, One by One!

pages.text: Spring rain poured outside. Careless Duri snatched a yellow raincoat from its hook. "I will splash first!"
Duri pushed arms through and grabbed the buttons. The top button went into the second hole; each next button went one hole too low. "Done!" Duri tugged the neckerchief knot.
The button row was crooked. The bottom button had nowhere to go. "Duri, your buttons..." timid Lala called. Duri had already run into the yard.
Splash, splash! Duri bounced in puddles. But the coat front gaped, letting rain in. Neck damp, tummy damp.
Duri shivered. "Brr, cold..." Turning away from the puddle, Duri hugged both arms around their body.
Teacher Bau brought dry clothes. While Duri changed, friends came back from the yard one by one. Outdoor playtime was over.
Duri pressed a nose to the window and watched the puddle. Beside Duri, Lala's buttons were neat. Lala pointed to the top one. "Buttons from the top, one by one!"
Hanging up the wet coat, Teacher Bau said, "Start at the top, one by one, and the rest line up." Teacher Bau pointed to the top button and top hole together.
It rained the next day too. Duri fastened buttons slowly. "One, top button first! Two, one by one down! Three, check the whole row!" The row was straight. Duri went outside first.
Teacher Bau lifted Duri high. "Now you are not wet at all!" Starting at the top kept rain out. Pointing to the puddle, Duri called, "Buttons from the top, one by one!"
